item.title: Woman shot and killed in Emporia home
item.description: Crime Insider sources say a woman was found with a gunshot wound inside an Emporia, Virginia home around 4 p.m.

item.title: Virginia Union University celebrates Black history through music at 'Still Rising' event
item.description: Virginia Union University played host to the "Still Rising: The Soundtrack of Black History" event at the Center for African American History and Culture Thursday evening.

item.title: VCU study finds significant disparities in telehealth access across Virginia
item.description: A new study reveals disparities in telehealth access across Virginia, with rural areas and communities with larger Black and minority populations less likely to use virtual healthcare services.
